item.title: Rsyslog: rsyslog: imuxsock trusted-property attribution spoofing via unescaped process name acknowledgement: rainer gerhards (rsyslog)
item.description: A flaw was found in rsyslog. This vulnerability allows a local user to spoof sender identity and cause downstream log consumers to misattribute event origins. When the imuxsock module is configured with plain trusted-property annotation, it fails to properly escape process names and executable paths in log metadata. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending log messages through the local log socket with…

item.title: SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System user logged.php authorization
item.description: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file admin/partials/user logged.php. The manipulation leads to missing authorization. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

item.title: Keycloak: keycloak: information disclosure via authorization bypass in admin api
item.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak. An authorization bypass vulnerability in the Keycloak Admin API allows any authenticated user, even those without administrative privileges, to enumerate the organization memberships of other users. This information disclosure occurs if the attacker knows the victim's unique identifier (UUID) and the Organizations feature is enabled.

item.title: Org.keycloak/keycloak-services: keycloak saml brokering: response delay due to unchecked notonorafter in subjectconfirmationdata
item.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak's SAML brokering functionality. When Keycloak is configured as a client in a Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) setup, it fails to validate the NotOnOrAfter timestamp within the SubjectConfirmationData . This allows an attacker to delay the expiration of SAML responses, potentially extending the time a response is considered valid and leading to unexpected session durations or…

item.title: Org.keycloak.services.resources.admin: keycloak: limited administrator can retrieve sensitive user attributes via admin api
item.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak Admin API. This vulnerability allows an administrator with limited privileges to retrieve sensitive custom attributes via the /unmanagedAttributes endpoint, bypassing User Profile visibility settings.

item.title: Enforce maximum recursion depth in encoding/asn1
item.description: Enforce a recursion limit in Unmarshal to prevent stack exhaustion when parsing deeply-nested, recursive structures.

item.title: Quadratic complexity in WordDecoder.DecodeHeader in mime
item.description: Decoding a maliciously-crafted MIME header containing many invalid encoded-words can consume excessive CPU.

item.title: CVE-2026-133303
item.description: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to leverage pre-staged malicious content to conduct an XML injection attack due to insufficient parameter validation. item.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)
item.description: Impact verify envelope bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken , validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify envelope bsp()…

item.description: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

item.title: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
item.description: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
item.description: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.
